faqs.question: Why take tTG Antibody-IgG Test?
faqs.answer: Test helps in diagnosis of celiac disease and to evaluate the effectiveness of a gluten-free diet

faqs.question: Is this test for you?
faqs.answer: Test is done on patient suffering from suspected Celiac disease

faqs.question: More Info on tTG Antibody-IgG Test
faqs.answer: Celiac disease antibody tests help diagnose and monitor the disease and a few other gluten-sensitive conditions. These tests detect autoantibodies in the blood that the body produces as part of the immune response. tTG, IgG may be used as an alternative test in people who have a deficiency of IgA.
